Download Minka Observations by Date Range

Source: R/mnk_obs_byday.R
mnk_obs_byday.Rd

Downloads observation data from the Minka API for a specified date range. When the result set exceeds 10,000 records, requests are subdivided by month or day to respect the API result limit.

Usage

mnk_obs_byday(d1, d2, ..., quiet = FALSE, limit_download = TRUE)

Arguments

d1

Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

d2

End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be on or after d1.

...

Arguments passed on to mnk_obs

query

A general search string passed to the API's q parameter.

taxon_name

A common or scientific taxon name.

taxon_id

A numeric identifier for a taxon.

user_id

A numeric identifier or login name for a user.

project_id

A numeric identifier or slug for a project.

place_id

A numeric identifier or slug for a place.

endemic

Logical value indicating whether to filter for endemic species.

introduced

Logical value indicating whether to filter for introduced species.

threatened

Logical value indicating whether to filter for threatened species.

quality

Quality grade to include: "casual" or "research".

geo

Logical value. If TRUE, filters for observations with coordinates.

annotation

Numeric vector of length two containing a term ID and a term value ID.

bounds

Bounding box, supplied as an sf object in EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) or as a numeric vector in the order c(nelat, nelng, swlat, swlng).

quiet

Logical value. If TRUE, suppresses console messages.

limit_download

Logical value. If TRUE (default), each request is capped at 10,000 records. If FALSE, the function attempts to download all records.

Value

A tibble with one row per observation and the fields returned by mnk_obs, except that photos are represented by url_picture (medium resolution) and url_picture_original. The result also includes species_guess. An empty tibble is returned if no observations are found.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Download observations of a taxon during March 2024
obs <- mnk_obs_byday(
  d1 = "2024-03-01",
  d2 = "2024-03-31",
  taxon_name = "Diplodus sargus"
)

# Download observations within a bounding box during the first week of 2024
# Bounds are ordered north latitude, east longitude, south latitude,
# and west longitude.
barcelona <- c(41.5, 2.3, 41.2, 2.0)
obs_bc <- mnk_obs_byday(
  d1 = "2024-01-01",
  d2 = "2024-01-07",
  bounds = barcelona,
  quiet = TRUE
)
} # }
